description: A call with a namespaced name calls the function declared with that name
notes: The spec has no namespaced function names, so ns::f() would be a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl parses the call (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go) and looks up the name joined with :: in the function table (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
